mapper.select: SELECT id FROM pms_product WHERE id=#{productId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND publish_status=1 AND del_flag=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pms_sku SET stock=stock-#{quantity} WHERE id=#{skuId} AND product_id=#{productId} AND #{quantity}>0 AND stock>=#{quantity}
mapper.select: SELECT pledge_id AS pledgeId, fingerprint, payload, total, available, reserved, awarded, consumed, retired FROM w17_noncash_pledge WHERE pledge_id=#{pledgeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE w17_noncash_pledge SET available=available+#{available}, reserved=reserved+#{reserved}, awarded=awarded+#{awarded}, consumed=consumed+#{consumed}, retired=retired+#{retired} WHERE pledge_id=#{pledgeId} AND available+#{available}>=0 AND reserved+#{reserved}>=0 AND awarded+#{awarded}>=0 AND consumed+#{consumed}>=0 AND retired+#{retired}>=0 AND #{available}+#{reserved}+#{awarded}+#{consumed}+#{retired}=0
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id AS reservationId, pledge_id AS pledgeId, member_id AS memberId, state FROM w17_noncash_reservation WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE w17_noncash_reservation SET state=#{state} WHERE reservation_id=#{reservationId} AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT award_id AS awardId, pledge_id AS pledgeId, member_id AS memberId, source_event_id AS sourceEventId, reservation_id AS reservationId, state, awarded_at AS awardedAt FROM w17_noncash_award WHERE award_id=#{awardId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE w17_noncash_award SET state=#{state} WHERE award_id=#{awardId} AND state='AWARDED'
mapper.select: SELECT award_id FROM w17_noncash_consumption WHERE source_receipt_id=#{sourceReceiptId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT kind FROM w17_noncash_audit WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} FOR UPDATE
